summary: Phase 7 of 8 complete: landed nested_sound_cut in Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Constructive/Nested/Soundness.lean via nested_sound_impL's B := A instantiation, the always-provable A imp A weakened through InputCtx.fillLhs_fm_antitone, and a new local bridge from (ctx.fillLhs empty).fm to ctx.fillEmpty.fm. That bridge required a genuinely new piece not spelled out verbatim in the plan: NestedRhs.box's fm translation is contravariant in its LHS argument (box Phi Psi .fm = box (Phi.fm imp Psi.fm)), so lifting Phase 6's landed OutputCtx.fillLhs_empty_imp_fillEmpty (forward direction, fillLhs-empty implies fillEmpty) through cs5DerivImpCongrLeft + cs5DerivBoxMono yields the reverse box-level implication, not the forward one nested_sound_cut needs. Resolved by adding a local private reverse-direction companion, cs5DerivFillEmptyImpFillLhsEmpty (fillEmpty implies fillLhs-empty), proved by the identical three-case induction on the OutputCtx as Phase 6's lemma but with the [Gamma] case discharged via a new tiny private combinator cs5DerivAndTopIntro (P imp (P and top)) instead of andE1 -- both directions are provable since the two formulas differ only by a redundant top-conjunct. This kept the phase's sole-owner constraint on Soundness.lean intact: no edit to Translation.lean was needed. Added the .cut arm to nested_sound (after .bStruct, matching Rules.lean's constructor order) and corrected the nested_sound section docstring (removed the stale 'every constructor except impL' sentence). Verification: scoped 'lake build Cslib...Nested.Soundness' succeeds with zero errors and zero warnings; full 'lake build' succeeds for the whole Cslib target (3259/3259 jobs) -- the first fully green build in this task, flipping the baseline RED (missing-cases diagnostic on NestedProof.cut) to GREEN; 'lake exe checkInitImports' passes silently; bash .claude/scripts/lean-sorry-census.sh Cslib confirms sorry_count: 40 (unchanged from Phase 5/6's baseline) with no Nested/Soundness.lean entry; lean_verify on both nested_sound_cut and nested_sound reports only the three standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), no sorryAx, no new custom axioms. Committed at bb537ac1 (Soundness.lean + plan markers only, narrow stage).
